subject: Agent System Architecture
significance: Decouples agent reasoning from external action execution, enabling modularity, extensibility, and interaction with diverse environmental capabilities.

subject: Agent Data Management
significance: Provides an immutable, auditable record of agent operations, observations, or metrics, crucial for debugging, evaluation, and historical analysis.

subject: Agent Performance Evaluation
significance: Transforms complex agent outputs or behaviors into discrete, measurable data points, facilitating objective assessment and iterative improvement.
